Class UserRegistrationModel

java.lang.Object
com.gcu.inventory.model.UserRegistrationModel
public class UserRegistrationModel extends Object
Model class representing user registration and account information. Contains user credentials and personal information required for registration. Includes validation constraints to ensure data integrity.

This model is used for:

  • User registration form binding
  • Spring Security authentication (UserDetailsService)
  • Database storage in the userinfo table

Security Note: Passwords stored in this model should be BCrypt-hashed before database persistence. Plain-text passwords should only exist temporarily during the registration form submission.
